Deprecated functions

Source: R/deprecated.R
vernissage-deprecated.Rd

Former names of the functions, from the analysis scripts the package comes from. They forward their arguments to the new function. The limit-of-detection and cut-off functions (make_cuts(), handle_lod(), bin_transition_table()...) moved to the lodestar package.

Usage

make_palette(...)

get_label(...)

p_to_stars(...)

rotate_x(...)

forest_plot(...)

export_table(...)

render_tabset(...)

raw_output_callout(...)

resolve_path(...)

var_catalog(...)

to_long(...)

add_deltas(...)

detect_outliers(...)

mask_outliers(...)

choose_transformation(...)

propagate_choice(...)

apply_transformation(...)

transform_boxcox_car(...)

transform_outcomes_car(...)

apply_outcome_transformation(...)

na_map(...)

complete_case_count(...)

composite_scores(...)

normality_table(...)

partial_rank_cor(...)

cor_test_matrix(...)

paired_visits_plot(...)

radar_plot(...)

expand_labels(vars, base_labels, visit_map = c(V0 = "V0", V3 = "V3"), ...)

visit_suffix_map(
  cols,
  select = "^MRI_",
  suffix_map = c(`36` = "V3", `0` = "V0")
)

outliers_table(
  df,
  vars,
  id_col,
  mad_threshold = 3.5,
  iqr_coef = 1.5,
  rule = c("mad", "iqr", "both", "any")
)

ggNA(
  data,
  Title = "Heatmap of missing values (NA)",
  colorNA = "#FDE725",
  colorPres = "#440154",
  show_na_stats = TRUE,
  ...
)

Arguments

...

Arguments passed to the new function.

vars, base_labels, visit_map

See label_expand() (vars is also the variable selection of outlier_detect()).

cols, select, suffix_map

See visit_map_suffix().

df, id_col

See outlier_detect().

mad_threshold, iqr_coef, rule

See outlier_detect() (mad_z_threshold, iqr_k, rule).

data

See plot_na_map().

Title, colorNA, colorPres, show_na_stats

Former arguments of ggNA(): title, colours of the missing and observed cells, labels with the count of missing values.

Value

The value of the new function.

Differences:

  • expand_labels() reads the former options fairpark.bin_label and fairpark.bin_label_root; label_expand() takes them as arguments;

  • visit_suffix_map() keeps the former default select = "^MRI_";

  • outliers_table() keeps its argument names (mad_threshold, iqr_coef) and Tukey's hinges (iqr_method = "hinges");

  • ggNA() keeps its argument names (Title, colorNA, colorPres, show_na_stats).
